items.title: IDC Frontier (Japan) cloud provider hit by ransomware
items.summary: IDC Frontier confirmed a ransomware attack beginning Oct 7 forced it to shut down its network and systems, disrupting about 495 client companies and local governments; no group named yet.

items.title: DexCom claimed by Redact group
items.summary: Redact listed US medical-device maker DexCom on its leak site on Oct 10 and claimed operational impact; the company has not confirmed.

items.title: City of Vicksburg, Mississippi systems shut down
items.summary: City computer systems were taken offline while officials investigate possible access to personal data; police, fire and 911 stayed operational.

items.title: UIC College of Medicine data theft
items.summary: University of Illinois Chicago College of Medicine reported data stolen from servers and some systems temporarily unavailable; main network and patient care unaffected.

items.title: Osaka Metropolitan University ~500 servers offline
items.summary: Aggregator reports around 500 servers went offline, taking down campus network and systems and cancelling classes; no primary university statement found.

items.title: Warlock hits four sectors via on-prem SharePoint
items.summary: A China-linked Warlock operation reportedly breached water utility, telecom, regional government and higher-education targets by exploiting on-premises SharePoint servers.

items.title: Qilin claims Japanese pro-video electronics maker
items.summary: CYFIRMA observed a Qilin leak-site claim against a Japanese manufacturer of professional video and imaging equipment; unconfirmed by the company.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup lists two redacted victims
items.summary: SilentRansomGroup posted partially redacted victims on Oct 5 and Oct 7 with full-data countdown timers running; names, sectors and countries not yet disclosed.

ransomware.note: Several items rest on leak-site claims or aggregator listings; only IDC Frontier is victim-confirmed with primary reporting.

items.title: Cloudflare DNS disruption (Oct 4)
items.summary: User forums report a Cloudflare disruption on Oct 4 affecting DNS resolution for many hours; no official post-mortem found, duration unverified.

items.title: Comcast network outage (Oct 8)
items.summary: ThousandEyes observed a Comcast outage across multiple regions lasting 1h21m that also affected partner networks and customers.

items.title: Microsoft 365 SharePoint Online access issues (Oct 1)
items.summary: Users reported being unable to reach SharePoint Online sites or seeing delays and navigation errors.

items.title: Cloudflare R2 / Durable Objects errors in Amsterdam (Oct 1)
items.summary: Cloudflare logged elevated error rates for Durable Objects and R2 storage served from Amsterdam.

items.title: MongoDB Atlas Triggers delayed (Oct 1)
items.summary: Some Atlas Triggers users saw delayed unordered trigger processing during a 5h14m incident.

items.title: 310 global network outage events, week of Oct 5–11
items.summary: ThousandEyes counted 310 outage events across ISPs, cloud provider networks, collaboration apps and edge networks for the week.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud region outage reported in October so far; items are smaller incidents.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure: three chained zero-days
items.summary: Volexity found attackers achieving root RCE on fully patched ICS VPN appliances; Ivanti patched CVE-2026-104935 on Oct 13 with a privilege-escalation fix still pending, so treat VPN-reachable credentials as compromised.

items.title: FortiMail zero-day CVE-2026-104286 exploited
items.summary: An actively exploited CVSS 9.8 flaw lets unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files on FortiMail appliances.

items.title: Cisco Secure FMC CVE-2026-20131 used by Interlock
items.summary: A CVSS 10.0 flaw in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center is being exploited for root access and pivoting to managed security devices; fixes are available and exploitation continues.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler zero-day can knock SAML offline
items.summary: Citrix patched a high-severity NetScaler ADC/Gateway flaw exploited in targeted attacks to cause denial of service on SAML deployments.

items.title: Zammad helpdesk zero-days used to breach DIVD
items.summary: Two exploited Zammad flaws were used to breach the Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure.

items.title: Bitget $388M loss via third-party zero-day
items.summary: A breach that surfaced Sep 24 grew to a $388M theft from hot and warm wallets via a zero-day in third-party security software, attributed to North Korea-linked actors.

items.title: NAIC PeopleSoft breach claimed by ShinyHunters
items.summary: Unauthorized access to the insurance regulator's PeopleSoft system, attributed to ShinyHunters' wider Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day campaign; disclosure date unconfirmed.

items.title: CISA KEV hits 247 entries for 2026 by Oct 1
items.summary: KEV additions for 2026 already exceed all of 2025, and most newer entries carry a three-day remediation deadline under BOD 26-04.

items.title: M 7.7 — 12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama (Oct 09)
items.summary: USGS orange PAGER alert for a major shallow-region quake in western Panama, followed by an M 6.6 nearby with a tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.6 — 14 km W of Río Grande, Panama (Oct 09)
items.summary: USGS yellow alert; tsunami flag set. Companion event to the M 7.7.

items.title: M 6.8 and M 6.7 — central Mid-Atlantic Ridge (Oct 13)
items.summary: Two offshore quakes, green alert; minimal impact on land expected.

items.title: M 6.3 — 102 km NE of Norsup, Vanuatu (Oct 08)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no significant damage expected.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias hits northern Gulf Coast
items.summary: First Atlantic hurricane of 2026 strengthened rapidly; states of emergency in AL, FL and GA with mandatory evacuations in the Panhandle and Dauphin Island and up to 9 ft of surge forecast.

items.title: Northern California Red Flag Warning
items.summary: Red Flag Warning around Redding, Chico and Sacramento with rapid fire-spread potential; small fire near Marysville threatened a residence on Oct 9.

physical.note: Reports differ on Isaias's landfall strength (Cat 2 vs Cat 3); check NHC. No 2026 typhoon coverage was found.
